description.text: Special Deck Set ex Venusaur, Charizard & Blastoise, released on 10 November 2023: three ready-to-play 60-card decks built around Venusaur ex, Charizard ex and Blastoise ex, the Pokémon Card 151 expansion's cards in new illustrations. Venusaur ex heals 60 damage from one of your Pokémon each turn while it is Active, Charizard ex's strongest attack does 330 damage, and Blastoise ex takes 30 less damage from attacks. Every card is a reprint, a few in new illustrations, and each deck has Nest Ball, Iono and Boss's Orders. Three coins, damage counters and markers, a playmat, guides, a damage counter case and a card box came with them. The set's list also runs past its 49 cards to full-art Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle numbered 050 to 052/049.
